notes.title: [v1.22.2]
notes.content:
[v1.22.2.0]
- Added a new challenge: "Fragile Glass"
- Added new perpetuation upgrades.
- Fixed a bug where the prism icon did not display.
- Fixed a display issue with the battle upgrades.

[Known Issues]
We are aware of issues where the Daily Bonus, Offline Bonus, and Steam Achievements may not function properly. We are actively investigating these problems. For the Daily Bonus, we plan to transition all related processes to server-side handling in the near future. We are also considering compensation for any missed rewards during this period. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: [v1.22.1]
notes.content:
- We believe we have identified and resolved the root causes of all crashes and freezes. If you have been experiencing frequent crashes or freezes, please update the game. Should the issue persist, we would greatly appreciate it if you could report it to us again.
- In the ranking system, the Max Sphere value will be temporarily reset, and the current currency will be sent to the leaderboard. Once this is done, the Max Number will start being recorded again. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
- Fixed inconsistencies with the Daily Bonus and Offline Bonus. Due to changes in the data structure, you may not be able to claim the bonuses on the first attempt after the update. If you continue to experience issues with claiming these bonuses, please let us know.
- The Prestige button has been enlarged and made more visible for easier access.

notes.title: [v1.22.0.1]
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the previous update was not applied correctly.

notes.title: [v1.22.0]
notes.content:
[Server]

- Adjusted the timing for displaying rankings to occur 3 seconds after the game starts. We hope this change contributes to a more stable game launch. If you continue to experience freezing issues, please let us know.
- Starting with this update, only versions newer than a specific minimum version will be able to submit scores to the rankings. This change ensures score consistency and fairness, especially during major game balance adjustments. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
- Please note that all rankings will be reset with this update. Thank you for your understanding.

[Game]

- Added three new bosses to Area 4.
- Fixed an issue where the third upgrade of the Celestial Upgrade was not applying the intended decay effect. This fix addresses the abnormal Sphere Multiplier values caused by this bug.
- Fixed a display issue where the effects of Battle Upgrades and Celestial Upgrades were not shown below their respective upgrades.
- Chaotics Generator upgrades will now be perpetuated by default.

notes.title: [v1.21.5]
notes.content:
- We have identified that the cause of the freezing issue was related to retrieving and sorting ranking data. As a temporary solution, we have modified the game logic to fetch ranking data on a background thread. This change is expected to alleviate the freezing issue. However, if you continue to experience freezes, we would greatly appreciate it if you could let us know.
- Optimized server time synchronization for better game stability. 
- Fixed an issue where Area 4 upgrades incorrectly required OmniSphere instead of EtherSphere.
- Added a boss to Area 3.
- Added a special area to Area 3.

notes.title: [v1.20.1]
notes.content:
### Patch Notes:
- **Offline Bonus Update**:  
  Offline Bonus is now calculated based on the time retrieved from the server. Please note that offline bonuses cannot be claimed if you play the game offline. To enjoy offline bonuses, ensure you are connected to the internet as much as possible!

**Note that as the server is placed on the US, some people might not recieve the offline bonus for the first time. We apologize for the inconvinience.**

- **Ranking Calculation Update**:  
Ranking Score is now calculated based on the number of Sphere and Battle Level altogether.  -> Score = Log(#sphere) * Battle Level. This is an experimental change so we'd really appreciate your feedback!

- Added Battle Deselect Option
- Fixed the issue where Chinese fonts are broken
- Fixed the issue where the Ether Sphere displays always 0
- If you perform Agency prestige at least once, the Agency generator starts to produce Agency
